changes.problem: SQLx user/password/dbname query parameters overrode URL userinfo/path replacements. The bootstrap URL has no such parameters.
changes.fix: Parse PgConnectOptions first, then force the migration login, its password and the app database. The privileged schema-provisioning connection also forces the app database after parsing.
changes.verification: Actual session_user/current_user/database, RESET ROLE from an app-owned function, a negative control using a superuser login plus SET ROLE, query DSNs, maintenance namespace/public ACL preservation, prod schema ownership and the existing history-read timeout.

changes.problem: The original per-release restore required both live copies to remain at the deployed hash, so partial restore failures prevented retry.
changes.fix: Maintain the tool in scripts, bind original backup/candidate hashes and the narrow diff, record progress/failure, atomically install, and allow each live copy at its recognized before/after generation. Restore can resume/recheck after failures at install, nginx test, reload, copy and journal writes. Unknown edits and symlinks are refused.
changes.verification: 24 offline fault-injection tests plus read-only loading of the existing release record. No Nginx mutation or reload was executed.

changes.problem: Cleanup required a saved installation ID, so response loss/status failure after deployment could skip stopping the app. Component details.name could overwrite the receipt step name.
changes.fix: Submit deploy once with --no-wait; observe accepted jobs and app state by appId/dev. Wait for active work before one stop submission. Unknown/failed cleanup makes the overall run fail. Explicit --keep-running true skips cleanup. Evidence schema 2 stores {name, details}; only validated public job/request UUIDs survive errors. A command timeout kills the CLI and waits for close before cleanup.
changes.verification: 19 stateful mock CLI scenarios including delayed/lost acknowledgements, status errors, pagination, another accepted action, stop failures and stable receipt names. Real-server v2 pilot execution remains NOT_RUN.

Updated the recommended Nginx recovery command and preserved its original command, historical results, tool and backup.

checksOnMergedTree.reason: The CLI suite stopped at its first check group: one of two concurrent `miy auth status` processes exited 3 with reauthentication_required. cli_login::session reads the saved credential without the interprocess lock, so a process that starts while another is renewing the token can read the uncertain state that the renewal stores before it sends. That code is the same in 600a56f and is not touched by this follow-up or by 42324ad. Not fixed here; recorded as an open defect.
